notes.notes:
core function:

3: Advisor (advisor) provides you with a standard play, the basic guarantee is not to lose money.
4: Before the action decision, provide the EV value of different actions and betsize.

notes.title: Solo King V2.1.1 is released
notes.notes:
1: Adjusted AI, 7 blind levels, 7 AI wisdom gradients, AI distinction is relatively obvious. You can get 4 rank medals for novice, veteran, expert, and master.

2: Good card system: Provide 20 kinds of common good cards to avoid the time wasted by users endlessly waiting for good cards to come.

3: Provide an indicator of the expectation that players can win when the player's largest hand continues to the next round at different stages of the deal. This is actually a predictive function of PokerSnowie.

4: During the game, the expression and language of AI will vary according to the trend of the game.

5: Showcase of clearance achievements: Intuitively display all kinds of card tables, all kinds of blind levels, all kinds of passes and trophies. A detailed display of the player's achievements.

6: Automatic login, automatically generate account. You can play both online and offline on the mobile phone, and online on the computer.
